title: Color Effect UI: tint/brightness/alpha/advanced for instances
description: Flash 8 Properties panel shows Color Effect dropdown when a symbol instance is selected: None/Brightness/Tint/Alpha/Advanced. The model already has colorEffect fields on SymbolInstance. Wire up the UI: add a Color Effect section to InstancePanel.tsx with a mode dropdown and sliders/inputs. On change, call updateInstance mutation. The SWF compiler should emit PlaceObject2 ColorTransform record when colorEffect != null. See docs/07-symbols-instances-library.md § Instance properties.
